scope: All claim JSON records and all result/research-run JSON blobs in recursive nontruncated agent-operations tree
classification_method: Read every claim/result blob; active/in_progress or execution_running=true require explicit disposition. Other checkpoints retained as work history, not proof of active writers.

unfinished_dispositions.scope: Actual accepted-package user walkthrough only; no product source changes or publication

unfinished_dispositions.limitation: Original claim preserved. Result completion/integration checked; current research state paused_by_owner with no claim; research authority not modified.
